_comment: CHECKED-IN egress ratchet baseline (S0.6). Exactly the modules under OmniSeek package that import a raw-egress library today (httpx / curl_cffi / socket / subprocess / yt_dlp), at module top OR inside a function. The S0.6 smoke checks hold it to the code in BOTH directions: a module that imports one of them and is not listed fails (a new raw-egress module must be routed through the shared egress or added here in a visible commit), and a listed module that no longer imports one fails too (it leaves the list in the same commit), so the list is never wider than the code. A listed module that no longer exists fails as well; the public mirror's sync drops the personal sources it leaves out from its copy of this list. The baseline is READ from this file, never recomputed as the reference, so a regression cannot self-satisfy.
